items.example: You should drink lots of water.

items.phrase: I've got a cold / flu / a temperature
items.example: I've got a temperature of 39 degrees.

items.phrase: I've got a cough / a sore throat / a runny nose
items.translation: У меня кашель / горло болит / насморк
items.example: I've got a cough and a runny nose.

items.translation: Принимайте эти таблетки три раза в день.
items.example: Take these tablets three times a day after meals.
